documents.text: Madi, Chitwan Madi (माडी नगरपालिका) is a municipality in Chitwan District of Nepal. With the population about 10,000, it is the fifth municipality in the district. Basantapur was the major town of the former Baghauda Village Development Committee (बघौंडा गा.वि.स.) that was incorporated into Madi Municipality. It is adjacent to Chitwan National Park. This municipality was formed by cabinet dated 2071-01-28 (BS). There were four village development committees before- Ayodhyapuri (अयोध्यापुरी), Kalyanpur (कल्याणपुर), Gardi (गर्दी) and Baghauda (बघौडा). Madi is a beautiful valley surrounded by jungles. In the north by Chitwan National Park and in the south bordered with India. It is a serene area with a close-knit community.
